listing.name: F-Zero X / n64hub
listing.summary: Race in a native Windows or Linux build using your own first-revision USA F-Zero X ROM.

steps.title: Open the project launcher
steps.instruction: Extract the archive for your system and open FZeroXRecompiled.exe on Windows or FZeroXRecompiled on Linux from the extracted folder. Keep the assets beside the program. Windows needs the Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable. Linux needs glibc 2.35 or newer, a Vulkan driver, GTK 3 and FreeType.

steps.title: Load your original game
steps.instruction: Choose Load ROM and select your own first-revision USA F-Zero X cartridge dump, a 16 MiB big-endian .z64. Then choose Start Game. Other regions and the 64DD expansion are outside this release’s ROM support.

references.title: Keep your racing records and settings
references.instruction: The project uses %LOCALAPPDATA%/FZeroXRecompiled on Windows and ~/.config/FZeroXRecompiled on Linux by default. Keep the actual profile if you use the project’s portable.txt marker or a Linux APP_FOLDER_PATH override. You maintain the downloaded program and should back up the profile separately.

warnings: The project’s game saves and settings stay outside Portcove’s backups.
